integrity: The proof reconstructs minimal residual smoothing as an A^2-orthogonal codimension-one projection, derives its exact Euclidean operator norm, and maximizes that norm over all SPD spectra with fixed condition number. The equality family is two-dimensional and exact. The original papers appeared in print in 1994, but the inspected publisher records did not expose a day-resolved print or preprint date; first_public_date therefore uses the earliest exact public online date verified for the cited sources rather than inventing a day.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one exact minimal residual smoothing step for real SPD systems, with unrestricted incoming candidate direction and Euclidean residual minimization over all real smoothing coefficients. It does not classify quasi-minimal residual smoothing, block smoothing, weighted residual norms, nonsymmetric systems, finite precision, or restrictions imposed by a particular primary iterative method.
title: Sharp Euclidean-error amplification law for minimal residual smoothing
